notes.title: "Tales of Xillia Remastered " will be available on Oct 31st, Friday
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Two Heroes, One Destiny[/b][/h1]

[previewyoutube=feXG0jHLpU8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Announcing the release of “Tales of Xillia Remaster,” the remastered version of “Tales of Xillia,” which was released in 2011 as the 15th anniversary title of the “Tales of” series.

An RPG set in a world where humans and spirits coexist has been remastered for modern consoles, offering stunning graphics and enhanced gameplay. Dive into the magnificent world of Rieze Maxia as either Jude Mathis, an aspiring medical student from the capital, or Milla Maxwell, a mysterious woman accompanied by four powerful spirits.[/h3]

[b]Product Page：[/b]https://www.bandainamcoent.com/games/tales-of-xillia-remastered
[b]Official X：[/b]https://x.com/TalesofSeries

Follow the paths of Milla and Jude as they embark on their daring journey through Rieze Maxia, a wondrous land where humans and spirits coexist in harmony.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766530/d913887cffa78164b3eb3fac7fec6b11c0efff6f.jpg[/img]
Master the Dual Raid Linear Motion Battle System, mustering strategy and coordination to overcome action-packed battles in real-time combat. Team up with allies to unleash devastating combo attacks and unlock special support skills to overwhelm your foes.

notes.title: Based on a Player Survey - Convenient QOL Functions Chosen by Players -
notes.notes:
Thank you for completing the Tales of Graces f Remastered player survey!

More than 8,000 players from around the world participated in the survey!
Based on the results of the survey, we will reveal the list of “most convenient new QOL options” chosen by players, and sharing some of their comments! 

[h3][b]Ranking by the Western region：
1st　「Faster movement][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215394/c1274c6a1ccc823909495aa3a2b7dd0901ac91dc.jpg[/img]
Comment：
Faster movement has made the game have a much better pace. Genuinely, I love this remaster!!

[h3][b]２nd「Additional subtitles for victory screen 」[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215394/8b89b27797df0d25a4457bfcf00ea0fc9cabec67.jpg[/img]
Comment：
Additional subtitles for victory screen is great, as I prefer to use Japanese dubbing with English subtitles so I usually miss these little details that add to the characters in other games.

[h3][b]3rd「Retry battles」[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215394/2f0ac78f6d6e1f3e3c7cffc4840f66a933059a88.jpg[/img]
Comment：
The retry battle function is great to reduce frustration and it encourages experimentation since the downtime between boss attempts is non-existent. 

[h3][b]Ranking by Asian region ：
1st「Faster movement」[/b][/h3]
Comment：
For older games that don't have fast travel like Tales of Arise, the faster movement is the lifeline that improves the play experience!

[h3][b]2nd 「Destination icon」[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215394/7475361092874065b0f771da71f19634577842cc.jpg[/img]
Comment：
The destination icons were really helpful.
I wanted to make a detour before I went on, so I was able to avoid accidentally going to the next objective.

[h3][b]３rd「Grade Shop from the first playthrough」[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215394/984c37c0bc700bff7b214bcb7a8370b42dad4554.jpg[/img]
Comment：
Since I had already played the game on a previous version, being able to unlock the grade shop from the first playthrough was especially convenient for progressing quickly. It's great that I can unlock everything first and then turn it on and off as needed.

Just as there are differences in which options people find most convenient depending on the region, the options that improve your quality of life in Tales of Graces f Remastered the most depend on your own play style!
These options can be switched on and off, so please enjoy the adventure of “Tales of Graces f” in your own favorite play style!

[h3]Please let us know in the comments if you have any favorite options or convenient ways to use them!

Please continue to enjoy “Tales of Graces f Remastered”.[/h3]

notes.title: 2009 JRPG Tales of Graces finally comes to PC in beautiful new remaster
notes.notes:
There's been a fantastic resurgence of classic JRPGs coming to PC in fresh new forms lately, with the likes of Romancing SaGa 2, Trails Through Daybreak, and Dragon Quest 3 all making their way to us over the past few months. The latest on the list is Tales of Graces f Remastered, the 2009 installment in the now 30-year-old series that most recently brought us the fantastic Tales of Arise. Marking the first time it's arrived on PC, and with a robust remaster featuring key quality-of-life updates, now's a great time to try an excellent RPG that you might have missed.

notes.title: Tales of Graces f Remastered Language setting

1. Open your Steam Library
2. Right-click the game title and select Properties.
3. Go to the Language tab
4. Select the language you wish to use from the drop-down menu

notes.title: Tales of Graces f Remastered (PlayStation 5) Review
notes.notes:
Tales of Graces f Remastered heralds the return of the 10th mainline or “mothership” Tales of title to modern platforms. Originally released all the way back in 2009 as an exclusive title for the Nintendo Wii in Japan, Graces eventually saw release in other territories, with the release of Tales of Graces f on the PlayStation 3 in 2012.

Tales of Graces f Remastered, then, is a port of a 15-year-old game, which, thankfully, due to its distinct art direction by the late Mutsumi Inomata, still looks and plays great today. In fact, Tales of Graces f Remastered is still my favourite combat system out of any Tales of titles.

Like other popular Tales games, Tales of Graces f Remastered features an anime-inspired narrative that places the player into a world divided by war through the lens of a child and his friends who, despite the passage of time, preserve and see things through after disaster strikes and splinters their sense of tranquility.
